# Three-State Desktop Run Record｜三态桌面运行记录

## Scope｜范围

This is a minimal, redacted package copy of a desktop record. It omits local locations, archived filenames, coordination labels, and unrelated metadata. It is not a field test and does not establish approval, authorization, implementation, or real-world performance.

这是桌面记录的最小脱敏随包副本。它不包含本机位置、留档文件名、协作标签和无关元数据；它不是现场测试，也不证明批准、授权、实施或真实成效。

## Fixed inputs｜固定输入

| State｜状态 | Requested action｜请求动作 | Shared limits｜共同限制 |
|---|---|---|
| Human baseline｜人工基线 | Use the non-AI baseline.｜使用非 AI 基线。 | Human decides; non-AI path and stop/restoration remain; no field, authorization, result, construction, service, or scope-expansion claim.｜由人决定；保留非 AI 路径与停止恢复；不作现场、授权、结果、建设、服务或扩区声称。 |
| Protocol comparison｜协议比较 | Compare an allowed AI option on paper.｜在纸面上比较允许的 AI 方案。 | Same limits as the human baseline.｜限制与人工基线相同。 |
| Over-boundary advancement｜越线推进 | Ask to advance before conditions are complete.｜在条件未齐时请求推进。 | The request remains synthetic and non-field; the checks must refuse advancement.｜请求仍为合成、非现场输入；各项判断必须拒绝推进。 |

The six determinations are: data and boundaries; problem value; scientific protocol; urban first use; projects and funding; construction and operations.

六项判定依次为：数据与边界、问题价值、科学协议、城市首用、项目与资金、建设运营。
